study: Phase 2 tranche T1: live smoke of the parallel best-of-N consumer, killed mid-map, resumed and reported
claims: measure-free figures only: no judge, no calibration, no quality claim, no comparison
pins: run_smoke.sh refuses any run whose runtime HEAD is not P2SMOKE_RUNTIME_COMMIT (the ledger's value) or whose program copy or price table differs from the pins; a paid run whose CLI is not named by P2SMOKE_CLAUDE_BIN (no PATH lookup), whose --version is not cli_version, that carries the stand-in marker, whose runtime tree is not clean or whose kit is not the runtime's own experiments/p2_smoke. smoke.json records the CLI's path and SHA-256 and the wrapper executes exactly that path. The readout checks the recorded values again (the runtime commit against P2SMOKE_RUNTIME_COMMIT, required for a verdict) and refuses a verdict to records whose rehearsal flag disagrees with the binaries the wrapper executed (the stand-in marker, a path inside the kit, a target other than the recorded CLI)

isolation.rule: every launched attempt has exactly one stream-json init event with the keys plugins, mcp_servers, skills, slash_commands, agents, model, session_id and claude_code_version; it lists no plugin but built-in ones (path builtin, source ending @builtin), no MCP server, skill or slash command, no agent outside builtin_agents and the model claude-haiku-5-5; no hook event in any stream, no hook record in the native transcripts, no usage row of another model, no codex or nested claude call, no provider attempt with output that no launch record names, and the native sessions are exactly the sessions the launched attempts name. The built-in sets are those of 2.1.322 (PQ-1c); these checks re-verify the flags' effect on every call of 2.1.323

spend.worst_case: 7 calls and about USD 3.5: the wrapper admits a call only while its figure (at or above real billing) stays at most USD 3, plus the CLI's documented overshoot of --max-budget-usd on at most two calls in flight (about USD 0.26 each for Haiku). Outside the kit's control (known_gaps): about USD 5.3 if an agent deletes the slot ledger (7 x (0.5 + 0.26)); up to three calls with no dollar cap, each stopped at 600 s, if an agent replaces the wrapper
spend.how: every call goes through smoke_claude.sh: the CLI's --max-budget-usd 0.5; launch slots launch-1 to launch-7 in the slot ledger (an eighth call is refused); a call is refused when the runtime's cap figure (cap_cost) of every earlier launch, with USD 0.5 for each launch without complete usage including this one, passes USD 3. The run also has --max-cost-usd 3. The resume has no --max-cost-usd: after the kill the held attempts have no usage.json, so a capped resume stops with spend_cap_unmetered by contract (specs/cli.md, Spend cap; observed in the rehearsal). Each call times out after 600 s; when the run stops for any reason the launcher closes the gate (a call still starting stops before the CLI) and terminates every recorded call whose pid, start time and session match its record, and records it
spend.retry: one retry in all, by resume of the same run (slot smoke-retry), only of a first attempt that did not complete, was killed as planned, has an infrastructure failure on every failed item, no model failure, no isolation failure and no spend stop; it makes at most 3 calls and the smoke at most 7

checks.stopped_mid_map: the run was killed exactly as planned: the coders of committed_at_kill committed, the coders of held_items held by the wrapper before their CLI started, no failed row and no timeout
checks.completed: after the last resume, report run.status is completed, the resume exited 0, and the four coders and the judge are committed
checks.no_redispatch: no identity has a started row after its committed row, and every coder committed before the kill has exactly one started row
checks.held_never_launched: no held attempt was launched (no launch record names it) and none has a usage.json
checks.usage_recorded: every launched attempt that was not refused has a usage.json that is reported and complete with output tokens; report run.usage.unknown_attempts equals the held attempts plus replaced attempts without usage, so partial is true only because of attempts that made no call
checks.report_tokens: report shows usage.tokens for each of the five provider steps and run.usage.tokens equal to their sum
checks.cost_under_ceiling: report run.usage.cost_usd is a finite number above zero and at most 3, and the CLI-reported costs of the launches sum to at most 3
checks.no_cost_stop: no call was stopped by the CLI's per-call budget (error_max_budget_usd), the run's cap (spend_cap_reached) or the wrapper's count or spend refusal (refused-calls.log)
checks.isolation: the isolation rule holds for every launched attempt, replaced or not: an isolation problem is an observation and is never erased by a retry
checks.no_model_failure: every failed item's launched attempt shows an infrastructure problem; a failure the model produced (an invalid result, a wrong path) is an observation, never retried

infrastructure_failure: the slot's smoke.json is missing, incomplete or names another slot, or the report is missing or exited nonzero
the kill did not happen as planned (stopped_mid_map false)
a call in flight was terminated by the launcher when the run stopped (its launch slot is spent)
a launched attempt with no usage or no output tokens: the CLI did not start, log in or answer
a launched attempt's init event is missing or lacks a key, or names a CLI version other than the slot's (version drift)
an API error result (is_error with api_error_status, or result text starting 'API Error')
the run could not meter a call (spend_cap_unmetered in run.log)

the fixture commit, program copy, price table or runtime commit is not the pinned one; a real slot ran a CLI other than cli_version, on a runtime with uncommitted changes, or from a kit outside its runtime
a launch with no attempt (no bundle): a CLI started outside an orchestrator attempt
replaced: after the retry, a first-slot attempt counts as replaced only when the retry launched a later attempt of the same effect; the infrastructure problems of a replaced attempt no longer count, those of every other attempt stay
decision_order: no verdict on a rehearsal, or on records whose rehearsal flag disagrees with the binaries the wrapper executed, or without P2SMOKE_RUNTIME_COMMIT (readout.py exits 2)
fail when the isolation check does not hold, whatever else holds
fail when an item failed with no infrastructure problem (no_model_failure), whatever else holds
undetermined when any infrastructure failure holds
fail otherwise, naming the checks that do not hold
readings: the brief's 'unknown_attempts 0, partial false' cannot hold after a kill mid-map: the held attempts exist in the memo and have no usage; the criterion requires instead that they made no call and are the only unknown attempts
a stop by a spend limit is an observation (no_cost_stop false gives fail), never retried; a wrapper refusal made no call and is not an attempt
a failure the model produced (a missing or invalid result) is a workflow outcome: no_model_failure false gives fail, never retried, even beside an infrastructure failure on another item
isolation is stricter than the coordinator's ruling asked: its problems are never erased, even on a replaced attempt
known_gaps: an agent can run the real CLI by absolute path, or leave a child that calls setsid: not prevented; detected afterwards only when its session lands under the workspace's native-session prefix

an operator running `orchestrator resume` by hand: the plain `claude` on their PATH has no wrapper, no flags and no count; not prevented; detected afterwards: an attempt with output and no launch record, and native sessions that differ from the launched attempts, fail the isolation check

an agent editing the slot's bin/ (made read-only, but the agents run as the same user with bypassed permissions): replacing the wrapper leaves up to three later calls with no dollar cap and no count, each stopped at its 600 s timeout; detected afterwards as calls without launch records; a wrapper that keeps the records but drops --max-budget-usd is not detected
an agent deleting the slot ledger resets the count and the figure: up to 7 calls at the per-call ceiling, about USD 5.3
a SIGKILL of run_smoke.sh skips its exit trap; the orchestrator still enforces each call's 600 s timeout, but if it is killed too (the whole tree), only --max-budget-usd bounds a call in flight
an interrupt (Ctrl-C) during resume lets the runtime drain its calls and exit 1; the readout then reads fail with no infrastructure entry: an interrupted run is a lost tranche
the readout reads attempts by the absolute paths recorded: read the results in place, never a moved copy
the real run writes session transcripts and CLI state to the operator's ~/.claude
can_decide: whether a parallel best-of-N run with a real provider survives a kill mid-map and completes on resume
whether a committed item is dispatched again on resume
whether every real call records usage and report shows tokens per step and a total
whether the smoke stayed under its cost ceiling
cannot_decide: the quality of any change or of the judge's choice
how often a kill or a call fails, or any rate: this is one run
elapsed time or cost of other tasks, models or N
a kill while a real call is in flight (the held coders never started their CLI)
the Codex adapter, or metering under a provider other than Claude
anchor: manifest.json lists the SHA-256 of this criterion and of every file that defines the smoke; its own SHA-256 is recorded in the plan's ledger, and run_smoke.sh refuses unless P2SMOKE_MANIFEST_SHA256 equals it
